goals.objective: Inventory JVM, Spark, Scala and runtime versions with evidence
actions: Inspect build files, CI and runtime configuration without source edits
goals.rollback: No source changes; restore report only if explicitly authorized

goals.objective: Evaluate supported JDK targets against Spark and Scala compatibility
actions: Document compatibility constraints and authoritative sources

acceptance.criterion: For this batch, persist an impact/coverage map with selected existing tests, justified additions and baseline/target execution requirements; document any conclusion that no critical impact was found

goals.objective: Define reversible migration batches and acceptance gates
actions: Specify scope, tests and rollback per batch
Map actual critical dependency/JDK impacts to application contracts, existing coverage and only the missing tests

goals.objective: Implement only an explicitly approved migration batch
actions: Add approved missing regression tests on a dedicated feature branch in a separate commit and capture baseline results before the dependency update where possible
Apply approved migration changes on the dedicated feature branch
goals.rollback: Revert approved batch commit after authorization

acceptance.criterion: Every identified critical behavioral risk is covered by equivalent executed baseline/target checks with evidence; report differences and unresolved gaps, or substantiate that no critical impact was found

goals.objective: Compare migrated behavior with Java 11 baseline
actions: Run authorized tests and document evidence-backed Go/No-Go
goals.rollback: Restore prior runtime configuration after authorization
